comment: Static 8-blade iris. Place base, then either an LVGL arc (mode colour, value=%) OR the discrete petal plates (timer_iris_petal_0..7, image_recolored to the mode colour), then seps, then the time label in the centre. down=orange (remaining), up=blue (elapsed).

petals.comment: 8 pre-rotated, baked petal plates (.2). Lit one at a time clockwise for a discrete 8-step aperture fill. Each PNG is the full 480x480 canvas with ONLY its blade opaque WHITE and the rest transparent — neutral white so TIMER-core can image_recolor it to the mode colour at runtime. NO runtime transform (ESP32-P4 PPA limits): rotation is BAKED into each PNG.
petals.recolor: white -> mode colour via LVGL image_recolor / img_recolor_opa
petals.petal_0: leading edge at the vertical-top seam
